posts.text: LinkedIn co-founder Reid Hoffman is pushing back after Trump's DOJ launched a criminal probe into his nonprofit, American Future Republic. He admitted indirectly funding E. Jean Carroll's legal bills against Trump but called the investigation "retaliation" and "absurdly false."
posts.summary: Criticizes DOJ probe into Reid Hoffman as political retaliation
